row.title: Node 24 on every workflow closes node-runtime
row.body: All workflow and seed node-version pins moved from 22 to 24 (Node 22 leaves maintenance 2027-04-30); Unlearn, seed/worker, site and dashboard suites passed on Node 24.22.3 before the bump; node-runtime is closed in doctrine/unattended.json, which lifts the Unlearn seed to autonomous.
row.probe: grep:doctrine/unattended.json::Every workflow and seed workflow now pins node-version 24
